name: 98-ui
description: Monorepo for the 98-pink Windows 98 UI revival: the CSS source of truth, its React and Vue ports, and the code they share.
author: Meorion <me@meorion.moe>

scripts.generate: bun run --filter 98-pink-react generate && bun run --filter 98-pink-vue generate
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @98-ui/tools typecheck && bun run --filter @98-ui/demo-content typecheck && bun run --filter 98-pink-shared typecheck && bun run --filter 98-pink-react typecheck && bun run --filter 98-pink-vue typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --filter 98-pink.css build && bun run --filter @98-ui/tools typecheck && bun run --filter 98-pink-shared build && bun run --filter 98-pink-react build && bun run --filter 98-pink-vue build
scripts.test: bun run --filter 98-pink.css test && bun run --filter @98-ui/demo-content test && bun run --filter 98-pink-shared test && bun run --filter 98-pink-react test && bun run --filter 98-pink-vue test
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
